related.title: 道格灘離岸風電場
related.transfer: 可遷移「一海里見方的配置」與「氣泡幕與打樁噪音」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；道格灘離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "A one-nautical-mile grid" and "Bubble curtains and piling noise" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Dogger Bank offshore wind farm must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦美國首座商業規模離岸風場：一海里方格配置、供料駁船、氣泡幕與葉片品質事件；道格灘離岸風電場則以英國首座以高壓直流併網的離岸風場：直流損失、無人換流平台、單圈發電量與全程效率為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first commercial-scale offshore wind farm in the United States: a one-nautical-mile grid, feeder barges, bubble curtains and a blade quality event; Dogger Bank offshore wind farm centres on britain's first offshore wind farm connected by HVDC: DC losses, an unmanned converter platform, energy per revolution and end-to-end efficiency, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與容量因數」與「年發電量與容量因數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「風功率與功率係數」的模型移到道格灘離岸風電場，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「無人換流平台的輕量化」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Annual energy and capacity factor".
Move the model of "Wind power and power coefficient" to Dogger Bank offshore wind farm, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Lightweighting the unmanned converter platform", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「一海里見方的配置」與「氣泡幕與打樁噪音」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；道格灘離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "A one-nautical-mile grid" and "Bubble curtains and piling noise" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Dogger Bank offshore wind farm must be respecified.

related.title: Haliade-X 離岸風機平台
related.transfer: 可遷移「一海里見方的配置」與「氣泡幕與打樁噪音」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Haliade-X 離岸風機平台的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "A one-nautical-mile grid" and "Bubble curtains and piling noise" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Haliade-X Offshore Wind Turbine Platform must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦美國首座商業規模離岸風場：一海里方格配置、供料駁船、氣泡幕與葉片品質事件；Haliade-X 離岸風機平台則以首款超過 12 MW 的離岸風機平台：同一葉輪的容量提升、葉根離心力與海上換葉片的代價為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first commercial-scale offshore wind farm in the United States: a one-nautical-mile grid, feeder barges, bubble curtains and a blade quality event; Haliade-X Offshore Wind Turbine Platform centres on the first offshore turbine platform above 12 MW: uprating on one rotor, centrifugal force at the blade root and the cost of changing blades at sea, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與容量因數」與「掃掠面積與比功率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「風功率與功率係數」的模型移到Haliade-X 離岸風機平台，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「結構自然頻率與 1P、3P」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Swept area and specific power".
Move the model of "Wind power and power coefficient" to Haliade-X Offshore Wind Turbine Platform, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Structural natural frequency and 1P, 3P", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「一海里見方的配置」與「氣泡幕與打樁噪音」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；Haliade-X 離岸風機平台的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "A one-nautical-mile grid" and "Bubble curtains and piling noise" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Haliade-X Offshore Wind Turbine Platform must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 葡萄園風電一號
history.text: 2018 年取得麻薩諸塞州的購電合約；2021 年取得聯邦許可並完成融資；2023 年離岸施工開始；2024 年首次送電，同年發生葉片斷裂事件。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2018: Power contracts with Massachusetts were won. 2021: Federal approval and financial close. 2023: Offshore construction began. 2024: First power, and the blade break in the same year. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
